worker_output.summary:
✅ Full production system implemented (762 lines).

Features:
  • Gross production: factories + population labor, scaled by Planetology TL (0.5→2.0 BC/pop) and mineral richness (×0.33→×3.0)
  • TECH diversion: reduces Active_Population before production calc
  • Pollution/cleanup: wasteRate × factories, cleanupModifier (eco restoration tech)
  • Net production: Gross − Cleanup (floored to integer BC)
  • Slider allocation: SHIP/DEF/IND/ECO split net; TECH generates RP from diverted pop
  • ECO phases: (1) cleanup → (2) growth bonus → (3) terraforming
  • Factory construction (IND): builds factories, carries progress, overflows at max
  • Slider rebalancing: proportional distribution among unlocked sliders, locks respected
  • Reserve overflow: IND/ECO overflow to Empire Reserve when planet maxed
  • Racial modifiers: production/research bonuses, factory efficiency (Mice 1.5×), RC level bonus (Mice +2)

All formulas per design/economy/slider-mathematics.md and factory-formulas.md.

Tests: 224/224 pass (38 new comprehensive tests covering all acceptance criteria).
Typecheck: clean.

verification_result.notes: All 4 acceptance criteria met. 5 sliders sum to 100% (validateSliders() enforces this with 1% tolerance). SHIP/DEF/IND/ECO/TECH calculations correct per slider-mathematics.md — TECH diverts population before gross calc, remaining 4 sliders split 100% of net production. Pollution (wasteRate × factories) and cleanup (0.5 × pollution × cleanupModifier) correctly implemented. 224/224 tests pass, typecheck clean, no DOM imports in src/game/.
